p: month: This was forty years after their departure from Egypt.
Miriam died there: Moses and Aaron's sister.
gathered themselves together against Moses and: Another rebellion was in Rephidim Ex 17:1-16, and this was in Kadesh.
rod: With which you did miracles in Egypt and divided the sea.
must we fetch you water out: The punishment which followed declared that Moses and Aaron did not believe the Lord's promise as it appeared in Nu 20:12.
sanctify me in the eyes of: That the children of Israel should believe and acknowledge my power and so honour me.
was sanctified in them: By showing himself almighty and maintaining his glory.
Edom: Because Jacob or Israel was Esau's brother, who was called Edom.
turned away from him: To pass by another way.
gathered unto his people: Read Ge 25:8.
